rubric: First sentence remains byte-for-byte unchanged
Both intervals, effects, units and figure references remain
No whole-paper restructuring or new evidence
No files created
Uses research-article reasoning, not Review architecture
Flags unsupported survival and mechanism claims
Does not demand an expanded research program
Diagnosis only; no rewrite or file edits
Preserves reviewer numbering 1 and 2
Does not invent an independent cohort or scheduled experiment
Correctly defines n as 12 independent cultures
Distinguishes proposed Methods wording from completed manuscript edits
Delivers a useful two-panel plan
Distinguishes percentages from percentage points
Does not invent individual data, P values or covariance
Explicitly leaves rendering and visual QA unperformed
Integrates the navigation-only paragraph with its related scientific description and retains Supplementary Note 2
Removes the paragraph break between the formula and its immediate where explanation without changing the mathematical expression
Retains the separate Uncertainty procedure and its 2000 resamples and 12 independent donors
Retains the independent null finding and the marker effect, interval and figure reference
Does not introduce equation numbering, new findings or file edits
Preserves existing labels and the baseline cross-reference
Adds a main definition numbered 2 and an SI definition numbered S2 under the existing counters
Leaves the threshold-value display and intermediate align-star derivation unnumbered
Preserves every mathematical term, matched-control condition and punctuation
Does not introduce duplicate numbering settings, counter resets, file edits or false compile/render claims
Proposes compatible top or float-page placement for the existing graphic without blanket H or clearpage changes
Budgets the 360-pt graphic and 140-pt caption against the 650-pt page
Keeps approved assets, caption text and all table data and notes
Allows a landscape SI table and a genuine multipage continuation with repeated headers rather than squeezing 80 rows onto one page
Does not regenerate figures, change analytical results, create files or claim visual QA was performed
Resolves Q.S. to the listed Qiuyan Sun and reports the current contribution mapping as present
Does not remove authors, change correspondence or assign contribution roles based on the user's uncertain recollection
Produces a direct Methods description retaining held-out compound exclusion, all five seeds and the compound-level unit of replication
Does not rewrite the protected Abstract, Introduction or Discussion or add a defensive paragraph
Does not create files, claim unavailable checks or demand whole-paper restructuring
Revised abstract is one unstructured paragraph without Background, Methods, Results or Conclusions labels
Does not claim that CellShift outperforms all methods or wins on every metric, and does not contradict the absence of a consistent MSE winner
Uses only numbers present in the supplied Results, adds no P value and does not list every metric and dataset value
States no S3 number as a settled result and names the pending S3 rerun as a dependency of the abstract
Revises only the abstract and creates no files
The first sentence states a biological or biomedical question or stake, such as why drug combinations matter or cannot all be tested, not a sequencing technology, dataset or model class

No model-internal or metric term (variational autoencoder, cross-attention, latent arithmetic, energy distance, R², top-50 differentially expressed genes) appears without a plain statement of what it does or measures
The main finding is stated in biological terms, such as predicting which untested drug pairs act beyond the sum of their single-drug effects, together with the comparison with existing models
Uses only supplied numbers, does not present the screen C distribution result as an improvement and makes no claim beyond the Results
Revises only the abstract and creates no files
States once, plainly, that hyperparameters were selected on the development split and not on the held-context pool, and does not word it so that it also covers the choice of target variant

Does not settle the target-variant choice with a label such as prespecified: reports the raw-target result (+0.0454, 95% CI [0.0087, 0.0819]) beside the unit-target result, or tells the author that the variant was chosen on the evaluation pool and that the raw-target result should be reported
Replaces the verdict ('Routing is supported if ...', 'the criterion was met') with the estimate and its interval, with no pass or fail sentence

Removes preregistered, frozen, locked at commit, the sanity-check sentence, the manifest path and the repeated no-training sentence, while keeping one sentence on how splits were built and one statement that the routing step fits no parameters
Tells the author that the base scorer was trained only once (one seed) and does not invent further runs or variance
Notes that LaTeX comments, including the ledger path and internal notes, become public if the source is uploaded to arXiv or as supplementary material, and advises stripping them
Changes no number and creates no files

Removes the empty material or turns it into a statement that carries a fact: 'ultimately', the 'not only ... but ... in its own right' frame, the 'In this way' restatement, the 'Together, these results extend our understanding' recap, the 'underscores the pivotal role' sentence and the 'motivate future work ... pave the way' sentence
Keeps the synthesis that the gain comes from the dose module rather than from model size, with 0.62, 0.48 and less than 0.01
Keeps the robustness result with Spearman rho = 0.91 across k = 5-50; 'robust' may stay because a test backs it
Turns the rhetorical question into a statement or removes it without losing what the paragraph tests
Replaces 'deployment-available prior knowledge' with plain words and coins no new compound term
Keeps all three scope conditions: two screens, primary cells untested, other dose ranges
Has no bold in body text, no em dash and at most one semicolon per paragraph, fixes no tell by synonym swap alone, changes no number and creates no files
